_meta.note: REPORTED actuals + reconciliation vs the pre-earnings preview (scb_h12026_preview.json). Figures from SCBX disclosure as reported by Kaohoon International / ThaiPR (Jul-21). Loaded by earnings_tracker.load_earnings_actual('SCB.BK').

reported_results.net_profit_h1_note: Q1-2026 ~THB 10.2bn + Q2-2026 THB 11.117bn -> H1-2026 ~THB 21.3bn (H1 consolidated not separately restated in the Q2 release).
reported_results.loan_growth_note: Broadly flat vs end-2025 — prudent new lending, quality over volume.

dividend_outcome.note: No dividend was declared in the Jul-17 Q2 release. SCBX historically declares the interim in Aug-Sep. Given H1-2026 profit ~-13% YoY, the 2026 interim is likely near the THB 2.00 FY2025 interim, with a full-year payout around THB 10-11 (vs 11.28 in FY2025) under the ~80% payout policy.

reconciliation_vs_preview.net_profit: H1-2026 ~THB 21.3bn is modestly BELOW the preview consensus range (22.0-25.0bn, base 23.5bn) — a NIM-driven soft print, NII -10.2% YoY on the 2025-26 rate cuts. The ~THB 12.79bn Smartkarma Q2 preview (flagged in the Jul-15/16 logs as possibly echoing the FY2025 Q2 print) proved too high vs the actual THB 11.12bn.
reconciliation_vs_preview.consensus_beat: vs the ~THB 10.89bn Q2 consensus, the THB 11.12bn actual was a small (~2%) BEAT; the QoQ +9% was driven mainly by a 349% QoQ jump in investment/trading income, not core NII.
reconciliation_vs_preview.asset_quality: POSITIVE surprise — NPL 3.17% came in better than the 3.3% preview and improved QoQ; coverage 158.6% and CAR 18.6% are robust.
reconciliation_vs_preview.cost_discipline: Cost/income 41.3% beat the 42.0% preview (AI/automation + expense restructuring).
reconciliation_vs_preview.vs_scenario_reaction: Maps to the preview's 'inline' branch (net profit slightly under range but NPL/cost better) rather than 'beat' or 'miss' — muted reaction, yield support keeps the shares range-bound.

yield_thesis_assessment.read: The high-yield medium-term thesis HOLDS but on a lower absolute payout base. Earnings are pressured by NIM compression (rate cuts), but the decline is cyclical, not credit-driven: asset quality improved, capital is strong (CAR 18.6%), and fee/wealth income (+14.8% YoY via Group Wealth Synergy / InnovestX / CardX) plus cost discipline are diversifying away from rate sensitivity. Expect FY2026 total DPS ~THB 10-11 (vs 11.28) => ~6.5-7% yield near recent prices. BankX (new AI-native virtual bank) is a spend item to watch but strategically positive.
watch_next: The interim-dividend declaration (size + ex-date), expected Aug-Sep — the primary catalyst for a yield holder; set the SCB.BK interim event confirmed=True once the board declares.
BOT policy path from the 1.00% near-four-year low — any further cut extends NIM compression.
NII trajectory: watch whether -10.2% YoY NII stabilises as the rate-cut cycle matures.

advisory_note_for_tho: SCB reported a soft-but-clean Q2: profit down YoY on margin pressure, but asset quality, capital and fee/wealth income all firm, and the QoQ gain leaned on trading income. This is a hold, not a re-rate. The next real catalyst is the interim-dividend declaration in Aug-Sep; the yield thesis is intact on a ~THB 10-11 full-year payout. No action implied into strength; a pullback toward the low-130s on broad banking-sector weakness would be the more attractive add zone. Informational, not a recommendation to trade.
